name: Mornye
profile: She is a researcher for the Spacetrek Collective and a professor for Exostrider Engineering at Startorch Academy. She was a student at Startorch Academy and an acquaintance of Rover 20 years before the Void Storm hit Lahai-Roi. With an unwavering dream to chart the course of humanity's exploration of the world beyond Solaris, she plays a key role in the technological developments of Lahai-Roi as a project head of the Spacetrek Collective Research Institute.
